C0140.title: Qufu Police Crack Novel Personal Information Infringement Case, Arresting Man Trading in Stolen Game Accounts
C0140.summary: Police in Qufu dismantled a criminal chain that used Trojan programs to steal gamers' login session data and virtual equipment. Over four million login session records were compromised and then used to hijack game accounts for resale, with the case involving more than 30 million yuan.
